description: Catalog of integrations flow connect knows how to probe. A probe passes when an MCP server with that name is configured in any installed tool, a CLI is on the PATH, or an environment variable is set (reported set/unset, never its value). A company adds its own entries in flow.config.json integrations[] with an explicit kind.

fix.default: install GitHub CLI (https://cli.github.com) and run: gh auth login
add the Atlassian MCP server to your tool, or install the jira CLI, or set JIRA_API_TOKEN
fix.claude: claude mcp add atlassian -- npx -y @atlassian/mcp-server (or your company's server)

fix.default: add the Linear MCP server to your tool, or set LINEAR_API_KEY
add the Slack MCP server to your tool, or set SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
add the Figma MCP server to your tool, or set FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN
add the Amplitude MCP server to your tool, or set AMPLITUDE_API_KEY
install the Databricks CLI, or set DATABRICKS_TOKEN
install sentry-cli, or add the Sentry MCP server, or set SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
npm i -D @playwright/test, or add the Playwright MCP server
